2124559708308779275.en_summary: Mayhem4Markets finds it ironic that Anthropic is a Public Benefit Corporation after building on one of the most egregious piracy operations, taking data without consent and commercializing it without consequences, now with the biggest cash pile in tech, while saying the public will be largely unemployable as models replace them, models trained on that pirated data. Quoted post states not planning to buy $ANT shares as it is fundamentally very expensive and culture seems broken and unethical, with IPO tomorrow.
2124559708308779275.zh_summary: Mayhem4Markets 認為 Anthropic 作為公共利益公司很諷刺，因為其建立在史上最惡劣的盜版作業之一上，未經同意取用大量數據並商業化卻無重大後果，現擁有科技界最大現金堆，同時表示公眾將在很大程度上失業，因為模型將取代他們，而模型正是以該盜版資訊訓練。引述帖文表示不計劃購買 $ANT 股份，因其基本面非常昂貴且文化似乎破碎不道德，IPO 明天進行。

ticker_notes.ANT: 基本面昂貴、文化破碎不道德，不計劃買入
